title: The City of the Jebusites/David’s Jerusalem
note: City plan of the City of David at about 1:6,000. Only four marked features exist today and can be pinned (Gihon Spring, the Jebusite tunnel/Warren's Shaft right beside it, the Siloam pool, En Rogel); the threshing floor is a schematic box, and walls and valleys are not points. Fewer than 5 landmarks, so not calibrated.
